rows.output: Ndị AM Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka ndị na-ese ihe"

rows.output: Otu onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na otu ya "na-emeghe uche" gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana o kwuru na ọ bụ obere ihe okwu ịgagharị site na MWP ruo Muppet.

rows.output: Ụlọ Nzukọ, nke na-arụ ọrụ na iwu iwu iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ maka nkọwa ọ bụla nke ihe ndị otu nzukọ bụ ga-abụ n'aka ndị otu ha."

rows.output: N'ọnwa Jun, Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ wepụtara nsonaazụ nke mkparịta ụka ọha na eze banyere atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ Welsh Parliament.

rows.output: Karịa nde mmadụ iri abụọ na-ekiri ikpe Brett Kavanaugh
rows.reference: Ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ nde 20 lelere ọnụnụ Brett Kavanaugh

rows.output: Puku ihe karịrị nde iri abụọ na otu na-ekiri ikpe ikpe ikpe ikpe Brett Kavanaugh na nwanyị ahụ na-ebo ebubo na o mere ya ihe ike n'afọ 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, na netwọkụ telivishọn isii.
rows.reference: Ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ ndị mmadụ nde 20 lelere nkwupụta akaebe nke Tọsde sitere n’aka Brett Kavanaugh onye ahọpụtara maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị yana nwanyị boro ya ebubo nke mwakpo n’ike mere na 1980, Christine Blasey Ford, na netwọk igwe onyonyoo isi.

rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, ọgbaghọ ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-aga n'ihu, ebe ndị na-ebufe ozi na-ebufe ihe ndị a na-eme kwa ụbọchị maka ihe mere n'izu ụka: nkwekọrịta nke onye ozi Arizona, Jeff Flake, mere ka ndị FBI mee nyocha otu izu banyere ebubo ahụ.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, nkwụsịdo ike ndọrọndọrọ ahụ gara n’ihu, ndị mgbasa ozi nọ na akwụsịbido mmemme ndị kwesịrị ịme maka ntụgharị nkeji ikpeazụ nke Fraịde ahụ: nkwekọrịta nke Onye Ọmeiwu Jeff Flake nke Arizona zubere maka FBI iji mee nnyocha otu-izu maka ebubo ndị ahụ.

rows.output: Ford gwara Kansul Ikpe nke Sineti na-ahụ maka ikpe na ọ nwere 100 pasentị nchegbu na Kavanaugh metụrụ ya aka n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi ma nwaa ịkpọpụta ya n'ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị.
rows.reference: Ford gwara Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu na o doro ya anya pasentị 100 na Kavanaugh ji anya mmanya pịa ya aka ma nwaa iyipu ya akwa n’emume ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndịrị.

rows.output: Kavanaugh, n'okwu na-enye obi ụtọ, kwuru na o ji 100 pasentị chee na ọ bụghị ihe mere.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh, na nkwupụta nwere oke mmetụta, kwuru na o doro ya anya pasentị 100 na ọ meghị.

rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ na ihe karịrị nde mmadụ iri abụọ na anọ, dị ka Nielsen kwuru na Fraịde, hụrụ ya.
rows.reference: Enwere ohere na ihe karịrị ọnụọgụ nde ndị mmadụ 20.4 nke Nielsen kwuru na Friday lelere ya.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-agbakọta ndị na-ekiri ihe na CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel na MSNBC.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-agụ nkezi nlele na CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel na MSNBC.

rows.output: N'ụzọ dị mwute, ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ọzọ na-egosi ya, gụnyere PBS, C-SPAN na Fox Business Network, adịghị mfe.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụgụ adịghị ozugbo maka netwọk ndị ọzọ gosiri ya, gụnyere PBS, C-SPAN na Fox Business Network.

rows.output: Na Nielsen na-enwekarị nsogbu ịtule ndị na-ekiri ihe n'ụlọ ọrụ.

rows.output: Iji mee ka ihe ahụ pụta ìhè, nke ahụ bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-ege ntị dị ka egwuregwu bọọlụ asọmpi ma ọ bụ ihe nrite Academy.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Fox News Channel, nke ndị na-eme ihe nkiri ya na-akwado nkwonkwo Kavanaugh, duuru ndị niile na-ahọpụta ndị na-ege ntị na 5.69 nde mmadụ n'oge niile nke ikpe ahụ, Nielsen kwuru.

rows.output: ABC bụ nke abụọ na ndị na-ekiri 3.26 nde.

rows.output: CBS nwere nde mmadụ 3.1, NBC nwere nde mmadụ 2.94, MSNBC nwere nde mmadụ 2.89 na CNN nwere nde mmadụ 2.52, Nielsen kwuru.

rows.output: Mmasị ka dị elu mgbe a nụchara ihe.
rows.reference: Mmasị rịrị elu ka ọnụnụ ahụ gwụchara.

rows.output: Flake bụ onye isi ihe na-eme na Fraịde.
rows.reference: Flake bụ onye agbadoro anya n’okwu nke Fraịde.

rows.output: Mgbe ụlọ ọrụ onye Republican na-ekwesịghị ekwesị, onye ga-azọ ọkwa ahụ, si na nkwupụta na ọ ga-azọ ọkwa Kavanaugh, a hụrụ ya ka CNN na CBS na-ekiri ka ndị na-eme ihe ike na-akwa ya emo ka ọ na-agbalị ịnya igwe mbuli elu gaa n'ụlọ ikpe.
rows.reference: Ka ụlọ ọrụ Repọblikan na agafeghị oke wepụtara nkwupute ya na ọ ga-atụnyeere Kavanaugh, igwefoto CNN na CBS jidere ya n’ụtụtụ Fraịde ebe ndị njegharị iwe na akpọ ya asị ka ọ na anwa ịbanye igwe nrigo na aga ọnụnụ Mgbakọ Ndị Ikpe.

rows.output: Ọ nọdụrụ ala na-ele anya n'ala ọtụtụ nkeji ka a na-akatọ ya, na-emetụte ya n'izuụka na CNN.
rows.reference: O ji obi umeala kwụrụ ọtụtụ nkeji ka a na akpọ ya iyi, a na egosi ya ozugbo na CNN.

rows.output: "Ana m m'ụkwụ n'ihu gị," otu nwanyị kwuru.

rows.output: "Ị chere na ọ na-ekwu eziokwu n'ụzọ dị iche?"

rows.output: A gwara ya, "i nwere ike mgbe ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị enweghị ike."
rows.reference: Agwara ya, “ị nwere ikike mgbe ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị enweghị ikike.””

rows.output: Flake kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ya ewerela ọnọdụ wee kwuo, tupu igwe mbuli emechie, na ọ ga-enwekwu okwu n'oge ikpe ndị kọmiti.
rows.reference: Flake kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ya ewepụtala nkwupute ma kwuo, tupu igwe nrigo ahụ emechie, na ọ ga-enwekwu ihe ndị ọ ga-ekwu n’ọnụnụ mgbakọ ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị ọrụ eriri na ndị na-ebufe ihe niile na-ekpuchi awa ndị dị ndụ ma emechaa, mgbe kọmitii ikpe ga-eme ntuli aka ịkwaga nkwado Kavanaugh na Senate dum maka ntuli aka.
rows.reference: Netwọk kebụl na mgbasa ozi nọ na ekpuchi ihe na eme ozugbo ka emechara, mgbe Mgbakọ Ndị Ikpe kwesịrị ituli aka iji kwagoo nhọpụta Kavanaugh n’aka Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu n’uju maka ntuli aka.

rows.output: Mana Flake kwuru na ọ ga-eme ya naanị n'okpuru ọnọdụ na ndị FBI ga-eleba anya n'ebubo e boro onye ahụ a họpụtara maka izu na-abịa, nke ndị Democrats na-erughị eru na-arịọ.
rows.reference: Mana Flake kwuru na ọ ga-eme nke ahụ naanị na nghọta na FBI ga-elenye anya na ebubo emere onye nhọpụta ahụ n’ime izu na esote, nke ndị Demokrats dị obere nọ na akwanye.

rows.output: Flake nwere obi ike n'ụzọ dị iche iche site n'otú o si na ndị enyi ya na ndị Sinetọ Democratic bụ Chris Coons na-akparịta ụka.
rows.reference: Agbanwere obi Flake obere na nkata ya na enyi ya, Onye Ọmeiwu Demokrat Chris Coons.

rows.output: Mgbe ya na Coons na ọtụtụ ndị omebe iwu ndị ọzọ kụrụ, Flake mere mkpebi ya.
rows.reference: Ka yana nkata Coons gachara, ọtụtụ ndị ọmeiwu mechara, Flake mere mkpebi ya.

rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar Welsh sun damu da "kama kamar kayan wasan kida"
rows.reference: Welsh AMs ta damu game da 'yadda ake zama kamar wawaye'

rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu 'yan majalisar a wani shiri da ake yi na canza taken su zuwa MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.output: Ya taso ne saboda shirye-shiryen canza sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a faɗin fagen siyasa suna damuwa cewa hakan na iya jawo wa su kunya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce, "ya damu da cewa yana da kama da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karanta a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh, twp yana nufin daft da pwp yana nufin poo.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani memba na jam'iyyar Plaid ya ce, "Ba mu yi farin ciki ba" kuma ya ba da shawarar wasu hanyoyin.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Conservative na Welsh ya ce kungiyar sa tana da "zuciya mai bude" game da canjin sunan, amma ya lura cewa yana da gajeren tafiyan magana daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A wannan mahallin harafin Welsh w ana furta shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin Yorkshire na Ingilishi.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wadda a halin yanzu tana rubuta dokoki don gabatar da canje-canje a cikin sunan, ta ce: "Shawaran karshe kan duk wani bayanin abin da ake kira mambobin Majalisar zai dogara ne ga mambobin kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba wa Majalisar Welsh ikon canza sunan ta.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wani tattaunawa na jama'a kan shawarwarun da suka samu goyon baya mai fadi na kiran majalisar da Majalisar Welsh.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: A kan batun sunan AMs, hukumar ta fi son mambobin Majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi yawan goyon baya a wani bincike na jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: Ana ganin AMs suna ba da wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma ƙalubalen cim ma yarjeji na iya zama damuwa ga Shugaban Majalisar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran ta gabatar da kundin tsarin mulki kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar gyarawa za ta hada da wasu canje-canje ga yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da ka'idoji kan cire mambobi da kuma tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: AMs za su sami karsashin kuri'a kan tambayar abin da za a kira su lokacin da suka tattauna kan dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Macedoniyawa ta tuka wa masu zaɓe a zaben da za a yi na canza sunan ƙasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a za su yi zaɓe ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan ƙasar su zuwa "Jamhuriyyar Arewa Masedoniya."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne domin magance takaddama da ke ci gaba da yi da makwabta kasar Girka, wadda ke da lardi mai suna Makedoniya.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi tsokaci na tsawon lokaci cewa sunan makwabcinta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan yankin ta, kuma ta yi adawa da duk wata neman shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Makedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya kasance mai adawa da zabe na suna, ya ce zai yi watsi da wannan zabe.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zabe, ciki har da Firaministan Zoran Zaev, sun ce canjin sunan kawai farashin da za a biya domin shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Sautunan Agogon St. Martin sun yi shuru yayin da majami'u ke fama da wahala a Harlem
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kan kowace kusurwa," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "A yau, babu komai."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya bayyana cewa bacewar mashaya ta zama abu mai ma'ana.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Yanzu mutane suna mu'amalar juna ta hanyoyi daban-daban"
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "Kantuna ba su zama dakunan 'yan uwantaka ba inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewa kudin daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dore ba kamar yadda shugabanni suka yi tsammani, "kuma nan ba da jimawa ba za su dawo inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Coci, ya kara da cewa, za a iya maye gurbinsu da gine-gine na gidan zama da gidan kwale-kwale da cikakkun mutane da ba za su taimaka wa majami'u da suka rage a wannan unguwa ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawaitar mutanen da ke sayen gidajen haya a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance 'yan fantsama ne," ya ce, "sannu kuma za su hanzarta ranar da waɗannan majami'u za su rufe gaba ɗaya saboda ba zai yiwu ba cewa yawancin mutanen da za su koma cikin waɗannan gidajen haya za su zama mambobin waɗannan majami'u."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: Dukkan majami'u biyu an gina su ne ta hanyar al'ummomin farare kafin Harlem ta zama birni mai yawan bakaken fata - Majami'ar Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin's shekaru goma bayan haka.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: An fara da cocin Methodist na farko ya bar wurin a shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Jama'ar baƙar fata da suke ibadar kusa da ita sun ɗauki ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An karɓi St. Martin ta wani taro baƙar fata a ƙarƙashin jagorin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin aikin masu sayar da kaya a kan titin 125, babbar hanya ta siyayya a Harlem, wanda ya yi adawa da daukar ma'aikata ko inganta bakaken fata.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wuta a 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma yayin da Father Johnson's parishioners suka yi shiri na sake gina shi, sun ba da umarnin carillon.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: An yi wa Rev. David Johnson, ɗan uban da ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, yana alfahari da cewa "ƙananun mutane na agogo."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararren mai kunna kaho a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu daban: "kyautar al'adu" da "kaho na tarihi mara maye gurbin."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Ƙwararre, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta kuma lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da aka yi wa baƙar fata, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babban motar a cikin cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce cewa St. Martin's bai maye gurbinsa ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.output: Abin da ya faru a St. Martin a cikin watanni da suka gabata ya kasance wani labari mai rikitarwa na masu gine-gine da masu aikin gini, wasu da masu kula da cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma ta cocin Episcopal.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Matacciyar majami'ar - hukumar da ke kula da al'ummar cocin, wanda ya kunshi shugabanni masu zaman kansu - ta rubuta ga bishop din a watan Yuli da damuwoyinsu cewa bishop din "zai yi ƙoƙarin watsar da farashin" ga majami'ar, duk da cewa majami'ar ba ta da hannu a cikin daukar masu zanen da masu aikin da bishop din ya tura.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu masu ibada sun yi korafi kan rashin gaskiya game da wani bangare na cocin.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.output: Wani kifi ya raunata yaro mai shekaru 13 a lokacin da yake nutsewa don kama lobster a California.
rows.reference: Babban kifin teku ya raunata mai iyon neman lobster ɗan shekaru 13 a California

rows.output: An yi wa wani yaro mai shekaru 13 hari da wani kifi mai ban mamaki a ranar Asabar yayin da yake nutsewa don lobster a California a ranar farko ta kakar lobster, jami'an sun ce.
rows.reference: Wani babban kifin teku ya kai hari da raunata wani yaro mai shekaru 13 a ranar Asabar a lokacin da yake iyon neman losbter a cikin California a ranar buɗe lokacin lobster, kamar yadda jami’ai suka ce.

rows.output: An kai harin ne da misalin ƙarfe 7 na safe kusa da bakin teku na Beacon a Encinitas.
rows.reference: Harin ya faru ne kawai kafin ƙarfe 7 na safe kusa da Bakin Tekun Beacon a cikin Encinitas.

rows.output: Chad Hammel ya gaya wa KSWB-TV a San Diego cewa ya yi iyo da abokai na kusan rabin sa'a a ranar Asabar da safe lokacin da ya ji yaro yana kira don taimako sannan ya yi iyo tare da gungun mutane don taimakawa wajen ceto shi daga cikin ruwa.
rows.reference: Chad Hammel ya fada wa gidan talabijin na KSWB-TV a San Diego yana iyo ne tare da abokansa na kusan rabin sa’a a ranar Asabar da safe a lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kururuwa shi ke nan sai ya nufi wurin tare da wani gungun mutane don su jawo shi waje daga ruwan.

rows.output: Hammel ya ce da farko ya yi tunanin kawai jin daɗin kama lobster ne, amma sai ya gane cewa yana ihu, "Na ciji!
rows.reference: Hammel ya ce da farko ya ɗauka wata annishuwa ce ta kama wani losbter, amma shi ke nan sai ya “gano cewa ihu yake yi, ‘An cije ni!

rows.output: Na ji ciwo!
rows.reference: An cije ni!’

rows.output: An yanke dukkan kashinsa," in ji Hammel ya ce da zarar ya isa yaron.
rows.reference: An buɗe kashin kafaɗarsa gaba ɗaya,” inji Hammel da ya gani a lokacin da isa wurin yaron.

rows.output: "Na yi ihu ga kowa da kowa ya fita daga ruwa: 'Akwai wani kifi mai kifi a cikin ruwan!'" Hammel ya kara.
rows.reference: “Na yi ihu ga kowa don su fita daga ruwan. Hammel ya ƙara da cewa, ‘Akwai babban kifin teku a cikin ruwan!”

rows.output: An yi wa yaron jirgin sama zuwa Asibitin Yara na Rady a San Diego inda yake cikin mawuyacin hali.
rows.reference: An ɗauki yaron a cikin jirgin sama zuwa Asibitin Yara na Rady da ke cikin San Diego inda aka jera shi a yanayi mai tsanani.

rows.output: Jinsin kifi da ya yi wa farmakin ba a san shi ba.
rows.reference: Ba a san irie-iren jinsunan babban kifin tekun da ya yi wannan harin ba.

rows.output: Jagoran lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles ya bayyana a wani taron manema labarai cewa an ga wani kifi a yankin makwanni kaɗan da suka gabata, amma an tabbatar ba wani nau'in kifi mai hatsari ba ne.
rows.reference: Kyaftin Larry Giles mai kula da rayuwa ya ce a gaban maneman labarai cewa an ga wani babban kifin teku a cikin yankin ‘yan makonni baya, amma an ƙudurta cewa ba daga wani jinsuna ne babban kifi mai haɗari ne ba.

rows.output: Giles ya kara wa wanda ya ji rauni rauni a jikin sa na sama.
rows.reference: Giles ya kara da cewa wanda abin da ya shafa ya ji raunuka munana a kan yankin sama na gadon bayansa.

rows.output: Jami'an sun rufe shingen bakin teku daga Ponto Beach a Casablanca zuwa Swami's a Ecinitas na tsawon sa'o'i 48 don bincike da dalilai na tsaro.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun rufe iso ga bakin tekun daga Bakin Tekun Ponto na cikin Casablad zuwa Swami's a cikin Ecinitas na sa’o’i 48 don dalilan bincike da kariya.

rows.output: Giles ya lura cewa akwai fiye da nau'ikan kifin shark sama da 135 a yankin, amma yawancin ba a daukarsu masu hatsari ba.
rows.reference: Giles ya lura cewa akwai fiye da jinsunan 135 na manyan kifin teku a cikin yankin, amma mafi yawa ba a ɗauka suna da haɗari.

rows.output: Shirye-shiryen Sainsbury na shiga kasuwar kayan kwalliyar da ke Birtaniya
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana shirye-shiryen shiga kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya

rows.output: Sainsbury's na fafata da Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams da shagunan kayan ado masu ban sha'awa da ma'aikatan da suka dace.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana ɗaukan Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams tare da irin ɓangarorin shagon salon kwalliya da aka ɗauka masa ma’aikata da ƙwararrun masu ba da taimako.

rows.output: A matsayin wani ɓangare na babban tashin hankali zuwa kasuwar kyau ta Birtaniya ta £2.8bn, wadda take ci gaba da girma yayin da sayar da kayan ado da kayan gida ke komawa baya, manyan kantunan kyau za a gwada a cikin shaguna 11 a faɗin ƙasar, kuma za a kai su ƙarin shaguna a shekarar gaba idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kyawu ya zo ne a lokacin da shagunan sayar da kayan abinci ke neman hanyoyin amfani da sararin shiryayye da aka yi amfani da su a da don TV, microwave, da kayan gida.
rows.reference: Zuba jari a harkar kwalliya yana zuwa ne kamar yadda manyan shagunan sayar da kaya ke fafutukar hanyoyi don yin amfani da gurbin da babu kome da a da na ajiye talabijoji ne, da na’urorin dafa abinci da kayan gida.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya ce zai ninka girman kayan shafaffensa zuwa samfuran 3,000, ciki har da alamomin kamar Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dr. PawPaw a karon farko.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya ce zai ruɓanya girma na abubuwan da zai samar na kwalliya har kusan kayayyaki 3,000, da suka haɗa da nau’uka kamar su Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dokta PawPaw a lokaci na farko.

rows.output: Rukunoni masu wanzuwa daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees kuma za su sami karin sarari tare da wuraren da aka yi wa lakabi irin na waɗanda aka samu a shaguna kamar Boots.
rows.reference: Ranji-ranji da ke nan daga L'Oreal, Maybelline da Burt's Bees su ma za su sami gurbi masu yankin nau’uka iri ɗaya da waɗanda ake samu a cikin shaguna kamar Boots.

rows.output: Kantin sayar da kayan abinci na sake fara samar da layin kayan shafawa na Boutique domin yawancin kayan su kasance masu cin ganyayyaki - wani abu da ake samun karbuwa sosai daga masu siye masu shekaru.
rows.reference: Haka kuma babban shagon zai sake ƙaddamar da ranjinsa na kayan zamani saboda mafi yawancin kayayyakin su zama na abotar vegan - wani abin da ke samun ƙaruwar buƙata ga kananan masu yin ciniki.

rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai sayar da turare, The Fragrance Shop, zai gwada shaguna a cikin shaguna biyu na Sainsbury, na farko da aka bude a Croydon, kudu London, makonnin da suka gabata, yayin da na biyu ya bude a Selly Oak, Birmingham, a karshen wannan shekarar.
rows.reference: Kari a kan haka, mai sarin turare wato Shagon Turare zai gwada samar da rangwame a cikin shagunan Sainsbury's guda biyu, na farkonsu wanda ya buɗe a cikin Croydon, kudancin Landan, makon da ya wuce sa’an nan na biyun zai buɗe a cikin Selly Oak, Birmingham, daga baya cikin wannan shekarar.

rows.output: Sayen kan layi da kuma sauyin zuwa siyan ƙananan kayan abinci a kullum a shaguna na gida yana nufin masu sayar da kayan abinci suna buƙatar yin ƙarin aiki don shawo kan mutane su ziyartar.
rows.reference: Sayan kaya ta yanar gizo da ‘yar matsawa zuwa sayan abinci kadan a kowace rana a shaguna masu samar da sauki na gida yana nufi ya zama dole manyan shagunan sayar da kayan su himmatu wajen jan hankalin mutane su ziyarta.

rows.output: An ce Mike Coupe, shugaban kamfanin Sainsbury, cewa shagunan za su yi kama da shagunan sasanta a hankali, yayin da kamfanin ke kokarin kare kansa daga kasuwar rangwame ta Aldi da Lidl, ta hanyar samar da karin ayyuka da kayan da ba na abinci ba.
rows.reference: Mike Coupe, shugaban Sainsbury's, ya ce shagunan gefen za su ci gaba da zama kamar manyan shaguna masu ɓangarori kamar yadda jerin babban shagon ke ƙoƙarin gasa da masu rangwame Aldi da Lidl tare da karin ayyuka da wanda ba na abinci ba.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ya yi aiki a kan wuraren Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna kuma ya gabatar da sabbin wuraren Argos da yawa tun da ya sayi duka sarkar shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda ya ce ya kara sayar da kayan abinci da kuma saukaka sayen duka sarkar.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana sa wuraren sayarwa na gefe na Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna haka kuma ya gabatar da wasu Habitats tun da ya saye gaba ɗaya jerinsu shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda yake cewa ya ƙara inganta cinikayyar kayan abinci inda kuma ya sa samun ya zama mai riba.

rows.output: Kantin sayar da kayan abinci na baya-bayan nan ya yi ƙoƙarin gyara sashen kyawawa da na magani, amma hakan ya ci tafiyarsa.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin da babban shagon ya yi na da a farfaɗo da ɓangarorin kwalliyar da magunguna ya ƙare babu nasara.

rows.output: Sainsbury ya gwada haɗin gwiwa tare da Boots a farkon shekarun 2000, amma haɗin gwiwa ya ƙare bayan cece-kuce kan yadda za a raba kudaden shagon magani a cikin shagunan su.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s ya gwada wani haɗin gwiwar kasuwanci tare da Boots a farkon shekaru na 2000, amma haɗuwar ta zo ƙarshe a bayan wani rikici na yadda za a raba kuɗaɗen da ke shigowa daga shagunan magani a cikin manyan shagunan nasa.

rows.output: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne bayan Sainsbury ta sayar da kasuwancinta na magani 281 ga Celesio, mai Lloyds Pharmacy, akan fam miliyan 125, shekaru uku da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne a bayan Sainsbury's ya sayar da kasuwancin nasa na shaguna 281 na magunguna ga  Celesio, mamallakin jerin shagunan Lloyds Pharmacy, a kuɗi Fam miliyan 125.

rows.output: Ya bayyana cewa Lloyds za ta taka rawa a cikin shirin, ta hanyar ƙara nau'in kayan kula da fata na alfarma ciki har da La Roche-Posay da Vichy a cikin shaguna hudu.
rows.reference: Ya ce Llyods zai taka wata rawa a cikin shirin, ta yin ƙarin wani ranji da aka faɗaɗa na nau’ukan kayan kula da fatar jiki na morewa da suka haɗa da La Roche-Posay da Vichy a cikin shaguna huɗu.

rows.output: Paul Mills-Hicks, Daraktan Kasuwanci na Sainsbury, ya ce: "Mun canza kamannin da kuma yanayin shagunanmu na kayan kwalliya don inganta muhalli ga abokan cinikinmu.
rows.reference: Paul Mills-Hicks, daraktan ciniki na Sainsbury's ya ce: “Mun canza gani da yadda ake ji na ɓangarorin kwalliya don inganta yanayi ga abokan cinikinmu.

rows.output: Mun kuma saka hannun jari a kan ma'aikata da aka horar da su musamman, waɗanda za su kasance a shafinsu don ba da shawara.
rows.reference: Mun kuma zuba jari a abokan aikinmu da suka sami horarwa ta musamman waɗanda za su kasance a kusa wajen ba da shawara.

rows.output: An tsara layin namu na al'adu don biyan duk wani buƙatu, da kuma kyawawan wurin da kuma wurin da ya dace da mu'ujiza, wanda ya sa mu zama wurin sha'awa na kyau wanda ya kalubalanci hanyar da ta gabata ta siyayya."
rows.reference: An tsara ranjinmu na nau’uka ne don dacewa da kowace buƙata kuma yanayin mai ƙayatarwa da wuraren da ke sauki wanda ke nufin wani wurin zuwa na kwalliya mai jan hankali da ke ƙalubalantar tsohuwar hanya ta sayan kaya.”

rows.output: Peter Jones ya yi fushi bayan Holly Willoughby ta janye daga yarjejeniyar fam miliyan 11.
rows.reference: Peter Jones 'ya fusata' bayan Holly Willoughby ya fita daga kwangila ta Fam miliyan 11

rows.output: Fitacciyar jarumar talabijin Holly Willoughby ta yi fushi da kamfanin kasuwancinta na al'ada, Peter Jones, bayan da ta yanke shawarar ficewa daga wata yarjejeniya ta fam miliyan 11 da ta yi da kamfanin nasa, don mayar da hankali kan sabbin kwangilolinta da Marks and Spencer da ITV.
rows.reference: Tauraron Dragons Den Peter Jones ya tafi a 'fusace' bayan mai gabatarwa a talabijin Holly Willoughby ta fita daga kwangila ta Fam miliyan 11 da irin salon nau’in rayuwarta ta kasuwanci don koma kan sababbin kwangilolinta tare da Marks da Spencer da ITV

rows.output: Willoughby ba shi da lokaci ga al'adar su ta suturar gida da kayan sawa, Truly.
rows.reference: Willoughby ba ta da lokaci na kayansu na gida da nau’in abubuwan tallafi na Truly.

rows.output: An kwatanta kasuwanci na ma'auratan da al'ummar Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop.
rows.reference: An alaƙanta kasuwanin nasu ga nau’i na Gwyneth Paltrow's Goop.

rows.output: Mai gabatar da Safiya, mai shekara 37, ta sanar da cewa za ta bar.
rows.reference: Mai gabatar da shirin Wannan Safiyar, mai shekaru 37, ta je Instagram inda ta sanar za ta tafi.

rows.output: Holly Willoughby ta barin tauraron Dragons Peter Jones cikin fushi ta hanyar janyewa daga kamfanin da suke da shi na rayuwa mai tsada a minti na karshe - don mayar da hankali kan sabbin kwantiragin ta da Marks & Spencer da ITV.
rows.reference: Holly Willoughby ta bar Dragons" tauraron Den Peter Jones cikin fushi ya ce ta fita daga nau’in salon kasuwancinsu mai samar da kuɗi a ƙarshen lokaci - don ta fuskanci sababbin kwangilolinta masu tsoka tare da Marks & Spencer da ITV

rows.output: An ruwaito cewa Jones ya yi "fushi" lokacin da TV's golden girl ta amince a wani taron da ya yi tsanani a ranar Talata a hedkwatar masarauta ta kasuwanci a Marlow, Buckinghamshire, cewa sababbin yarjejeniyoyinta - har zuwa £ 1.5 miliyan - ba ta da isasshen lokaci don ba da himma ga al'amuran su na kayan gado da kayan sawa da suna Truly.
rows.reference: Kafofi sun ce Jones ya ‘fusata’ ne a yayin da sananniyar yarinya talabijin ɗin ta tabbatar a lokacin wata tattaunawa mai tsauri a ranar Talata a hedikwatar babban kasuwancin nasa a cikin Marlow, Buckinghamshire, cewa sababbin kwangilolin nata - da suka kai har Fam miliyan 1.5 - na nufin yanzu ba ta da lokaci isasshe da za ta bata ga kayansu na gida da nau’in abubuwan tallafi na Truly.

rows.output: "Yana da sauƙi a zama shugaban ƙasa, amma maimakon samun mutane 10,000 a waje suna ƙoƙarin shiga wannan filin wasa mai cikawa, za mu sami kusan mutane 200 suna tsaye a can," Trump ya ce, yana nuna ga taron da ke gaban shi.

rows.output: Kodayake sama da kashi 10 na yawan jama'ar Lombok sun rasa matsugunansu, ba a bayyana bala'in kasa ba, wanda ya zama dole don haifar da taimakon kasa da kasa.

rows.output: "A cikin yawancin lokuta, abin takaici, sun bayyana sosai cewa ba sa neman taimakon kasa da kasa, don haka yana da wahala kadan," Ms. Sumbung ta ce.

rows.output: Yayin da Save the Children ke tattara tawagar da za ta tafi Palu, har yanzu ba a tabbatar da ko ma'aikatan kasashen waje za su iya aiki a kan filin ba.

rows.output: Mista Sutopo, mai magana da yawun hukumar bala'in kasar, ya ce jami'an Indonesia suna tantance halin da ake ciki a Palu don ganin ko za a bada damar hafsoshin kasa da kasa su taimaka wajen aikin agajin.

rows.output: A cikin yanayin girgizar ƙasa da Indonesia ke fuskanta a kullum, ƙasar na cikin haɗari mai tsanani daga fushin yanayi.

rows.output: Yayin da aka gina wuraren zama a Aceh, ba su da yawa a kan sauran gabar teku.

rows.output: Rashin gani na siren gargaɗin tsunami a Palu, duk da cewa an yi gargaɗin, mai yiwuwa ya ba da gudummawa ga asarar rayuka.

rows.output: A lokacin da ya fi kyau, tafiya tsakanin tsibiran Indonesia da yawa yana da wahala.

rows.output: Jirgin asibiti da aka sanya a Lombok domin kula da wadanda suka jikkata a cikin girgizar kasa yana kan hanyar zuwa Palu, amma zai ɗauki akalla kwanaki uku kafin ya isa wurin bala'in da ya faru.

rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya mai da hankali wajen inganta abin da ya faru a Indonesia, wanda ya kasance cikin yakin neman zabensa, kuma ya kashe kudi sosai a kan hanyoyin da hanyoyin jirgin kasa.

rows.output: Amma rashin isassun kudaden shiga ya damu da gwamnatin Mista Joko yayin da yake fuskantar sake zabe a shekarar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Amma rashin isassun kuɗaɗe ya addabi gwamnatin Mista Joko a lokacin da yake fuskantar sake zaɓe a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: Mista Joko kuma yana fuskantar matsi daga rashin jituwa da ke ci gaba da faruwa a Indonesia, inda mambobin rinjaye na musulmin Musulunci suka rungumi wani nau'in addinin da ya fi tsauri.

rows.output: A cikin wannan rikici, an kashe mutane sama da 1,000, kuma an yi garkuwa da mutane da yawa daga gidajensu, yayin da ƙungiyoyin Kirista da Musulmin ke fafatawa a kan titi, suna amfani da wukake, kibau, da kuma wasu makamai masu saukin kai.

rows.output: Jami'an 'yan sanda sun yi kira ga mutane a yankin da suka ga ko sun ji wani abu da ya faru, su fito fili.

rows.reference: Ẹ̀wẹ̀, àlàfo jìnjìn kan ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí farahàn lórí omi Òkun Pacific tí ó sì ńlọ sí apá ìlà-oòrùn láti dójúkọ Etíkun Ìwọ̀-oòrùn orilẹ-ede U.S. Bí Rosa ti ńsúnmọ́ erékùsù Baja Carlifonia lọ́jọ́ ajé bíi ìjì ilẹ̀ olóoru yóò bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí taari omi jínjìn ti ilẹ̀ olóoru sí ìhà àríwá lọsí ìwọ̀-oòrùn gúúsù orilẹ̀-ede U.S.

rows.output: Lẹ́yìn náà, ìdàpọ̀ ọ̀yàyà tó ń bọ̀ ní ìbàjẹ́ pẹ̀lú ìkùukù, yóò ṣẹ̀dá òjò tí ó pọ̀ jù lọ ní gbogbo agbègbè Gúúsù ìwọ̀-oòrùn ní ọjọ́ tó ń bọ̀.

rows.output: Ni agbegbe, 1 si 4 inches ti ojo le fa iṣan omi ni kiakia, awọn ṣiṣe idoti, ati awọn iṣan ni aginju.

rows.output: Ìdàpọ̀ ìrì dọ̀tí tó jinlẹ̀ yóò fa ìkùnsín omi láti dé 2 sí 3 inches ní wákàtí kan ní àwọn ibi kan, pàápàá ní àwọn apá gúúsù Nevada àti Arizona.

rows.reference: Yóò jẹ́ àmọ̀ràn tí kò dára láti jáde síta sí inú aṣálẹ̀ náà pẹ̀lú ẹsẹ̀ níbití òjò olóoru tí ńdúnkóókò láti rọ̀.

rows.output: Òjìji tó lágbára lè jẹ́ kí àwọn àfonífojì di odò tó ń rọ̀ ní kíákíá, ìjì líle yóò sì mú kí afẹ́fẹ́ tó ń bọ́ ní àgbègbè kan, ó sì máa ń fọ́ ìrì.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ̀ òjò leè fa kí àwọn àfonífojì di àwọn odò tó ńbínú fùfù tí àwọn ìjì abójòrìn yóò sì mú àwọn afẹ́fẹ́ agbègbè àti eruku tó ńfẹ́ lọ́wọ́.

rows.output: Ìdàpọ̀ òjò tó ju ìdá méjì lọ ní ìwọ̀n, èyítí ó lè fa àwọn ìkùnsín kékeré àti àwọn ọ̀nà tó tutù.

rows.output: Èyí yóò jẹ́ ìkùnsínkù ìkùnsínkù àkọ́kọ́ ti agbègbè yìí ní àkókò ìrì.

rows.output: Diẹ ninu awọn ojo ojo otutu ti o tan kaakiri yoo bẹrẹ si sunmọ Arizona nigbamii ni ọjọ Sundee ati ni kutukutu ọjọ Aarọ, ṣaaju ki ojo naa to di diẹ sii ni kutukutu ni ọjọ Aarọ ati ọjọ Tuesday.

rows.output: Oṣù Kẹwàá lè rí àwọn ìyípadà ìgbóná tó lágbára káàkiri orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà nígbà tí Arctic ń tutù, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn ìtọ́jútó ń dúró ṣinṣin.
rows.reference: Oṣù Ọ̀wàrà leè rí àwọn ìlọsókè-sódò kan nínú ìwọn ooru tàbi otútú jákè-jádò orilẹ-ede U.S. bí ìhà Arctic tí ńtutù síi, ṣùgbọ́n agbègbè olóoru sì m'óoru síbẹ̀.

rows.output: Nígbà míì, èyí máa ń yọrí sí àwọn àyípadà tó lágbára nínú ìwọ̀n ìgbóná ní àwọn ibi tó kéré jù.
rows.reference: Nigba miran èyí ńyọrísí àwọn ìyípadà tó yanilẹ́nu nínú ìwọ̀n otútù tàbí ooru ní àwọn ọ̀nà ìrìn tó kúrú.

rows.output: Ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn àpẹẹrẹ ńlá ti ìyípadà ìwọ̀n ìgbóná ní àárín U.S. ní ọjọ́ Sunday.
rows.reference: Àpẹẹrẹ ńlá tóyanilẹ́nu kan wà nípa ti àwọn ìyàtọ̀ ìwọ̀n otútù tàbí ooru ní gbogbo ààrin gùngùn orilẹ-ede U.S. lọ́jọ́ Àìkú.

rows.output: Àwọn ìwọ̀n ìgbóná ní Kansas City, Missouri, àti Omaha, Nebraska, yàtọ̀ sí 20 ìwọ̀n, àti láti St. Louis sí Des Moines, Iowa.
rows.reference: Ìyàtọ̀ tó fẹ́rẹ̀ tó ìwọ̀n ogún dìgírì ti otútù tàbí ooru lówà láàrin Ìlú Kansas, Missouri, àti Omaha, Nebraska, àti láarin St. Louis àti Des Moines, ní Iowa.

rows.output: Ní ọjọ́ díẹ̀ tó ń bọ̀, ìgbóná ìgbà ẹ̀rùn tó kù yóò gbìyànjú láti kọ́ àti láti fọ́ lọ́pọ̀lọpọ̀.
rows.reference: Nínú àwọn ọjọ́ díẹ̀ tó ḿbọ̀ lọ́nà, ìmóoru ìgbà ooru tí yóò pẹ́ yóò gbiyanju láti kọ́lé tí yóò sì gbòòrò lẹ́ẹ̀kan síi.

rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn apá àárín àti ìlà oòrùn U.S. ni a ń retí pé yóò ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ October tó gbóná pẹ̀lú àwọn ọgọ́rùn-ún 80 láti àwọn Ìlà Oòrùn sí àwọn apá ìlà oòrùn.
rows.reference: Ọ̀pọ̀ nínú agbègbè ààrin gungun àti ìlà-oòrùn orilẹ-ede U.S. ní wọ́n ńretí láti rí ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ ooru títí dé oṣù Ọ̀wàrà pẹ̀lú àwọn ìwọ̀n ọgọ́rin káàkiri láti Àwọn Ọ̀dàn Gúúsù náà sí àwọn apá ti Ìlà-oòrùn Àríwá.

rows.output: Ìlú New York lè dé 80 ìwọ̀n ní ọjọ́ Tuesday, èyí tó jẹ́ ìwọ̀n 10 ìwọ̀n lókè àbájade.

rows.output: Ìtọ́kasí ojú ọjọ́ wa fún ìgbà pípẹ́ ń fi hàn pé ó ṣeé ṣe kí ìgbóná tó ga ju ti àgbègbè ìlà oòrùn U.S. lọ ní ìdá kejì ti October.
rows.reference: Àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ ojú-ọjọ́ ọlọ́jọ́pípẹ́ wa ńtọ́kasí àwọ̀n ìṣọwọ́ṣeéṣe tóga fún àwọ̀n ìwọ̀n otútù tàbí ooru eyiti ó ju agbedeméjì lọ fún ìlà-oòrùn orilẹ-ede U.S. nínú gbogbo ìlàjí àkọ́kọ́ ti oṣù Ọ̀wàrà.

rows.output: Láàrin mílíọ̀nù 20 ènìyàn ló wo ìgbọ́ràn Brett Kavanaugh
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan tóju mílíọ̀nù ogún lọ ló wo ìgbẹ́jọ́ Kavanaugh

rows.output: Láàrin ọgọ́rùn-ún méjì [20] mílíọ̀nù ènìyàn ló wà ní ìwò ó ní ọjọ́ Tọ́kàndé, tí wọ́n ń wo ìtọ́jú tí ilé ẹjọ́ gíga ti yàn, Brett Kavanaugh, àti obìnrin kan tí ó fi ẹ̀sùn kan an pé ó fà á lọ́wọ́ nígbèèrè ní ọdún mẹ́wàá sẹ́yìn, Christine Blasey Ford, lórí àwọn nẹ́ẹ̀tì mẹ́fà.
rows.reference: Àwọn eniyan tóju mílíọ̀nù ogún ló wo ìjẹ́ẹ̀rí amóríyá ti ẹnití a fàkalẹ̀ fún Ilé Ẹjọ́ tógajùlọ Brett Kavanaugh àti ti obìnrin tí o fẹ̀suǹ kàn án pé ó bá òun lòpọ̀ lọ́nà àìtọ́ eyiti ó sọpé ó ṣẹlẹ̀ nínú àwọn ọdún tówà láàrin1980 si 1989, Christine Blasey Ford, lórí àwọn ìtàkùn ẹrọ amóhùnmáwòrán mẹ́fà.

rows.output: Ní báyìí, ìdúróṣinṣin òṣèlú náà tẹ̀síwájú, pẹ̀lú àwọn olùgbọ́ ìròyìn tí ń fọ́kù sí ètò ìtàgé fún ìyípadà ìkẹyìn ní ọjọ́ Jimọ: ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ tí Sẹnetọ́ Arizona Jeff Flake ṣe fún FBI láti ṣe ìwádìí ọ̀sẹ̀ kan lórí ẹ̀sùn náà.
rows.reference: Lọ́nà miran ẹ̀wẹ̀, ipò òṣèlú èmikògbà-ìwọkògbà náà tẹ̀síwájú, pẹ̀lú àwọn agbóhùnsáfẹ́fẹ́ tó ńdá àwọn èto tíwọn ńṣe ìdákúrekú fún àwọn ètò tóyẹ fún ìyípadà ìṣẹ́jú tógbẹ̀yìn ọjọ́ Ẹtì: àdéhùn kan tí Aṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà Jeff Flake ti Arizona ṣètò rẹ̀ fún àjọ FBI láti ṣe ìwáàdí ọlọ́sẹ̀ kan lórí àwọn ẹ̀sùn náà.

rows.output: Ford sọ fún Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìdájọ́ Aláṣẹ Sénẹ́tì pé ó ní ìdánilójú 100% pé Kavanaugh ti fọwọ́ kan rẹ̀ nígbèkùndùn, ó sì gbìyànjú láti yọ àwọn aṣọ rẹ̀ kúrò ní ìpàdé ilé ẹ̀kọ́ gíga kan.
rows.reference: Ford sọ fún Ìgbîmọ̀ Ètò Ìdájọ́ ti Àwọn Àṣojú-ṣòfin Àgbà wípé ó dá òun lójù ní gbogbo ọ̀nà pé Kavanaugh fí ọwọ́ pa òun lára fún ìtẹ́lọ́rún ara rẹ lẹ́yìn tí ó mutíyò àtipé ó gbìyànjú láti bọ asọ kúrò lára òun ní òde àríya ilé-ẹ̀kọ́ gíga kan.

rows.output: Kavanaugh, ní ìdánilójú, sọ pé òun ní ìdánilójú pé kò sí.

rows.output: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí àwọn ènìyàn tó ju mílíọ̀nù 20.4 lọ tí Nielsen sọ ní ọjọ́ Jimọ́ tí wọ́n ń wo rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ó ṣeé ṣé kí ó jẹ́pé àwọn eniyan tó ju mílíọ̀nù ogun àti ẹgbẹ̀rún lọ́nà irinwo ti Nielsen ròyìn rẹ̀ ló wò o.

rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ náà ń ka àwọn olùwòran àpapọ̀ lórí CBS, ABC, NBC, CNN, Fox News Channel àti MSNBC.

rows.reference: Láti fi ìyẹn sójú ìwòye, ìyẹn jẹ́ ìwọn olùwòran tó dàbí ti ìdíje eré bọ́ọ̀lù aláàfẹ̵sẹ̀gbá kan tàbí ti Ìgbàmì-ìdálólá Academy.

rows.output: Ìtòlẹ́sẹẹsẹ Fox News Channel, tí àwọn olùkópa rẹ̀ ti ṣe atilẹyin fún ìdìbò Kavanaugh, ṣe ìtọ́sọ́nà nínú gbogbo àwọn nẹ́ẹ̀tì pẹ̀lú àwọn olùwò 5.69 mílíọ̀nù ní àkókò gbogbo ìgbọ́wọ́ náà, nígbèyìn.
